description: Image Description: The image features a close-up view of two intersecting street signs mounted on a black post. One sign reads "W. ST. CLAIR ST" and the other reads "S. MAIN ST." Above the signs, there is a hanging basket overflowing with vibrant pink flowers and green foliage. In the background, part of a building with a large arched window is visible, along with a cloudy sky. The scene suggests an urban or suburban street corner with decorative elements.
